title: A Visit to Aunt Lily
setting: Aunt Lily's cozy room in her house, on an autumn afternoon.

characters.name: Mia
characters.look: Mia, a young girl with short brown hair and a red sweater

characters.name: Sam
characters.look: Sam, a young boy with blond hair and a blue shirt

characters.name: Aunt Lily
characters.look: Aunt Lily, a kind woman with long black hair and glasses

sentences.en: In October, Mia and Sam visit their aunt.
sentences.zh: 十月，米娅和萨姆去看望他们的姨妈。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia, a young girl with short brown hair and a red sweater and Sam, a young boy with blond hair and a blue shirt walk up to a house with orange autumn leaves on the ground.

sentences.en: Their aunt is resting in her sunny room.
sentences.zh: 他们的姨妈正在她阳光充足的房间里休息。
sentences.scene_prompt: Aunt Lily, a kind woman with long black hair and glasses rests in an armchair with a blanket in a sunny room.

sentences.en: She opens Mia's card and starts to smile.
sentences.zh: 她打开米娅的贺卡，开始露出笑容。
sentences.scene_prompt: Aunt Lily, a kind woman with long black hair and glasses opens a handmade greeting card and smiles, Mia, a young girl with short brown hair and a red sweater beside her.

sentences.en: "I feel fine today," she says to them.
sentences.zh: “我今天感觉很好。”她对他们说。
sentences.scene_prompt: Aunt Lily, a kind woman with long black hair and glasses talks cheerfully to Mia, a young girl with short brown hair and a red sweater and Sam, a young boy with blond hair and a blue shirt.

sentences.en: She lets Sam cut the cake for everyone.
sentences.zh: 她让萨姆给大家切蛋糕。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sam, a young boy with blond hair and a blue shirt cuts a round cake on a small table while Aunt Lily, a kind woman with long black hair and glasses watches.

sentences.en: When they finish, they watch birds from the window.
sentences.zh: 吃完以后，他们从窗户看鸟。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia, a young girl with short brown hair and a red sweater, Sam, a young boy with blond hair and a blue shirt and Aunt Lily, a kind woman with long black hair and glasses look out of a window at birds in a tree, empty plates behind them.

sentences.en: Aunt Lily sometimes tells funny stories about her life.
sentences.zh: 莉莉姨妈有时会讲她生活中的趣事。
sentences.scene_prompt: Aunt Lily, a kind woman with long black hair and glasses tells a story with lively hands while Mia, a young girl with short brown hair and a red sweater and Sam, a young boy with blond hair and a blue shirt laugh.

sentences.en: "Our plan is to come back tomorrow," says Mia.
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia, a young girl with short brown hair and a red sweater hugs Aunt Lily, a kind woman with long black hair and glasses goodbye at the door, Sam, a young boy with blond hair and a blue shirt waving.
